## Prepare variable combinations for multivariate EDM
Include influenza activity, influenza vaccination coverage, temperature, and absolute humidity to assess improvements in forecasting non-influenza respiratory virus activity.
```{r chunk09_01_mul_ccm_prepare}
data_obs.null <-  data_country_obs_null
seed_num <- 1117
sur_num <- 100

all_vars_other <- c(virus_name)
all_vars_flu <- c("INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL")
var_pairs0 <- expand.grid(all_vars_other, all_vars_flu)
var_pairs0$Var3 <- rep("Vaccine Temp AH", nrow(var_pairs0))
var_pairs0$mul_drivers <- paste0(var_pairs0[,1]," ",var_pairs0[,2]," ",var_pairs0[,3])
colnames(var_pairs0) <- c("target","flu","vero","mul_drivers")
print(var_pairs0$mul_drivers)
rownames(var_pairs0) <- var_pairs0$mul_drivers
all_vars3 <- unique(var_pairs0$mul_drivers)
print(all_vars3)
```

### Multiview Embedding
Perform multiview EDM using the observed data.
```{r chunk09_02_mul_ccm_actual_data}
# Set multiview parameters
vars_num <- 5 
# library size
lib_num <- c(1,NROW(data_country.norm))
#lag
E_num <- 4

# Perform multiview EDM for each variable combination
Mul_obs_summary <- foreach(var = all_vars3, .packages = needed_packages) %dopar% {
Mul_obs_country <- data.frame()

for (D_num in 1:(vars_num)) {
  Mview <- Multiview(dataFrame = data_obs.null,
                     lib = lib_num,
                     pred = lib_num, 
                     E = E_num,
                     D = D_num, 
                     multiview = ncol(combn(vars_num*E_num, D_num)),
                     columns = as.character(var_pairs0[var,"mul_drivers"]), 
                     target = as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"]),
                     trainLib = TRUE, 
                     parameterList = TRUE,
                     numThreads = used_cores,
                     excludeTarget = FALSE, 
                     showPlot = F) 

  Mul_view <- Mview[["View"]] %>%
  mutate(
    var_col = pmap(select(., starts_with("name_")), ~ paste(gsub("\\(.*", "", c(...)), collapse = ", "))
  ) %>%
    filter_at(vars(starts_with("name_")), any_vars(grepl(paste0(var_pairs0[var,"target"],"\\(t-1\\)"), .))) %>%
    filter_at(vars(starts_with("name_")), 
            all_vars(!grepl(paste0(var_pairs0[var,"target"],"\\(t-0\\)|",
                                   var_pairs0[var,"target"],"\\(t-2\\)|",
                                   var_pairs0[var,"target"],"\\(t-3\\)"), .))) %>% 
    arrange(across(starts_with("Col_")))
  

duplicates <- Mul_view %>%
  select(starts_with("name_")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(same_prefix = any(duplicated(gsub("\\(.*", "", c_across(everything())))))

  Mul_view$same_prefix <- duplicates$same_prefix

 Mul_rho_max <- Mul_view %>%
    filter(!same_prefix) %>%
    select(-same_prefix) %>%
    group_by(var_col) %>%
    filter(rho == max(rho)) %>%
    mutate(
      var_col = as.character(var_col),
      var_num = D_num,
      country=country_name
    )

  Mul_obs_country <- rbind(Mul_obs_country, Mul_rho_max)
}

Mul_obs_country  <- Mul_obs_country %>% select(var_num, var_col, rho, MAE, RMSE, country, everything())
Mul_obs_country$mul_drivers <- var

  return(Mul_obs_country)
}

names(Mul_obs_summary) <- all_vars3
mul_combined_obs <- bind_rows(Mul_obs_summary)
mul_combined_obs <- as.data.frame(mul_combined_obs)
mul_combined_obs$method <- "Observed"

# Export country-specific multiview EDM results
out_path0 <- "02_output/02_CCM/03_mul_CCM/01_mul_CCM_country_result"
dir.create(out_path0)
write.csv(mul_combined_obs,paste(out_path0,"/", country_index, "_mul_ccm_obs_result_",
                                 country_name,".csv", sep=""),row.names = F)
```


### Multiview EDM with Ebisuzaki Surrogates
```{r chunk09_03_mul_ccm_ebisuzaki_null_data}
Mul_ebi_summary <- foreach(var = all_vars3, .packages = needed_packages) %dopar% {
Mul_obs_country <- subset(mul_combined_obs, mul_drivers == var)
Mul_ebi_all <- c()
for (num in 1:sur_num) {

  data_null.lag <- data_obs.null[, c("year_decimal", virus_name,
                                     paste0("INF_A_ebi.", num),
                                     paste0("INF_B_ebi.", num),
                                     paste0("INF_ALL_ebi.", num),
                                     paste0("Vaccine_ebi.", num),
                                     paste0("Temp_ebi.", num),
                                     paste0("AH_ebi.", num))]

  for (i in 0:(E_num-1)) {
    suffix <- ifelse(i == 0, "(t-0)", paste("(t-", i, ")", sep = ""))
    data_null.lag[paste0(as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"]), 
                         suffix)] <- dplyr::lag(data_null.lag[,as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"])], i, default = NA)
    for (col in c("INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL","Vaccine","Temp","AH")) {
      for (j in num) {
        col_name <- paste0(col, "_ebi.", j)
        data_null.lag[paste0(col, suffix)] <- dplyr::lag(data_null.lag[col_name], i, default = NA)
      }
    }
    }
  
  data_null.lag <- data_null.lag[, !grepl("_ebi", names(data_null.lag))]
  
  n_rows <- nrow(Mul_obs_country)
  Mul_ebi <- c()
  for (row_id in 1:n_rows) {
    drive_col <- unlist(Mul_obs_country[row_id, grepl("name_", names(Mul_obs_country))])
    drive_col <- drive_col[!is.na(drive_col)]
    
    pred <- block_lnlp(
      data_null.lag, 
      target_column = as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"]), columns = drive_col,
      first_column_time = TRUE, stats_only = FALSE)
    
    Mul_ebi_row <- pred[["stats"]]
    Mul_ebi_row$sur_id <- num
    Mul_ebi <- rbind(Mul_ebi, Mul_ebi_row)
    Mul_ebi <- as.data.frame(Mul_ebi)

  }
  
  Mul_ebi_all <- rbind(Mul_ebi_all, Mul_ebi)
  Mul_ebi_all <- as.data.frame(Mul_ebi_all)
}

Mul_ebi_all$var_col <- gsub("\\([^)]+\\)", "", Mul_ebi_all$cols)

Mul_ebi_all$var_col <- gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", Mul_ebi_all$var_col)

Mul_ebi_all$var_col <- gsub(" ", ", ", Mul_ebi_all$var_col)

Mul_ebi_all <- Mul_ebi_all[, c("var_col", names(Mul_ebi_all)[1:ncol(Mul_ebi_all)-1])] %>%
  mutate(country = country_name)
Mul_ebi_all$mul_drivers <- var

return(Mul_ebi_all)
}

names(Mul_ebi_summary) <- all_vars3

mul_combined_ebi <- bind_rows(Mul_ebi_summary)
mul_combined_ebi <- as.data.frame(mul_combined_ebi)

mul_combined_ebi$method <- "Ebisuzaki"
mul_combined_ebi <- lapply(mul_combined_ebi, function(x) {
    if (is.list(x)) {
        return(unlist(x))  
    } else {
        return(x)
    }
})
mul_combined_ebi <- as.data.frame(mul_combined_ebi)
write.csv(mul_combined_ebi,paste(out_path0,"/", country_index, "_mul_ccm_ebi_result_",
                                 country_name,".csv", sep=""),row.names = F)
```

### Multiview EDM with Random Surrogates
```{r chunk09_05_mul_ccm_random_null_data}
Mul_ran_summary <- foreach(var = all_vars3, .packages = needed_packages) %dopar% {
Mul_obs_country <- subset(mul_combined_obs, mul_drivers == var)
Mul_ran_all <- c()
for (num in 1:sur_num) {

  data_null.lag <- data_obs.null[, c("year_decimal", virus_name,
                                     paste0("INF_A_ran.", num),
                                     paste0("INF_B_ran.", num),
                                     paste0("INF_ALL_ran.", num),
                                     paste0("Vaccine_ran.", num),
                                     paste0("Temp_ran.", num),
                                     paste0("AH_ran.", num))]

  for (i in 0:(E_num-1)) {
    suffix <- ifelse(i == 0, "(t-0)", paste("(t-", i, ")", sep = ""))
    data_null.lag[paste0(as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"]), 
                         suffix)] <- dplyr::lag(data_null.lag[,as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"])], i, default = NA)
    for (col in c("INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL","Vaccine","Temp","AH")) {
      for (j in num) {
        col_name <- paste0(col, "_ran.", j)
        data_null.lag[paste0(col, suffix)] <- dplyr::lag(data_null.lag[col_name], i, default = NA)
      }
    }
    }

  data_null.lag <- data_null.lag[, !grepl("_ran", names(data_null.lag))]
  
  n_rows <- nrow(Mul_obs_country)
  Mul_ran <- c()
  for (row_id in 1:n_rows) {
    drive_col <- unlist(Mul_obs_country[row_id, grepl("name_", names(Mul_obs_country))])
    drive_col <- drive_col[!is.na(drive_col)]
    
    pred <- block_lnlp(
      data_null.lag, 
      target_column = as.character(var_pairs0[var,"target"]), columns = drive_col,
      first_column_time = TRUE, stats_only = FALSE)
    
    Mul_ran_row <- pred[["stats"]]
    Mul_ran_row$sur_id <- num
    Mul_ran <- rbind(Mul_ran, Mul_ran_row)

  }
  
  Mul_ran_all <- rbind(Mul_ran_all, Mul_ran)
}

Mul_ran_all$var_col <- gsub("\\([^)]+\\)", "", Mul_ran_all$cols)

Mul_ran_all$var_col <- gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", Mul_ran_all$var_col)

Mul_ran_all$var_col <- gsub(" ", ", ", Mul_ran_all$var_col)

Mul_ran_all <- Mul_ran_all[, c("var_col", names(Mul_ran_all)[1:ncol(Mul_ran_all)-1])] %>%
  mutate(country = country_name)
Mul_ran_all$mul_drivers <- var

  return(Mul_ran_all)
}

names(Mul_ran_summary) <- all_vars3

mul_combined_ran <- bind_rows(Mul_ran_summary)

mul_combined_ran$method <- "Random"

mul_combined_ran <- lapply(mul_combined_ran, function(x) {
    if (is.list(x)) {
        return(unlist(x))  
    } else {
        return(x)
    }
})
mul_combined_ran <- as.data.frame(mul_combined_ran)
write.csv(mul_combined_ran,paste(out_path0,"/", country_index, "_mul_ccm_ran_result_",
                                 country_name,".csv", sep=""),row.names = F)
```
